newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin delays nuke restart until weekend.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin delays nuke restart until weekend.

text.p: Wisconsin Electric Power Co has postponed restart of its 485 megawatt Point Beach nuclear power unit 1 until the weekend for further restart testing, a company spokeswoman said Wednesday.
The company had said earlier this week the unit would likely return to service by Wednesday morning following a shutdown Feb 18 to repair a cooling system pump.
"It is in a hot shutdown mode now," spokeswoman Jackie Olson said, adding the unit would "probably restart sometime this weekend."
The adjoining 485 megawatt Point Beach nuclear unit 2 remained shut for maintenance and refueling which began in October, 1996.
Point Beach 2, also located in Two Rivers, Wis., was scheduled to restart in early April.
Wisconsin Electric is a subsidiary of Wisconsin Energy Corp.
